uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: 1264-inchi hijriy, dalv oyining o‘n yettinchisi, qishki kunlarning biri, quyosh botqan, tevarakdan shom azoni eshitiladir...
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Saroy ahli kunduzgi ish kuchlaridan bo‘shab hujralariga qaytqanlar, ko‘b hujralar kechlik osh pishirish ila mashg‘ul, shuning uchun kunduzgiga qarag‘anda saroy jonliq: kishilarning shaqillashib so‘zlashishlari, xoxolab kulishishlari saroyni ko‘kka ko‘targudek.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Og‘ir tabi’atlik, ulug‘ g‘avdalik, ko‘rkam va oq yuzlik, kelishgan, qora ko‘zlik, mutanosib qora qoshliq va endigina murti sabz urgan bir yigit.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Bas, bu hujra bino va jihoz yog‘idan, ham ega jihatidan diqqatni o‘ziga jalb etarlik edi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Qandog‘dir bir xayol ichida o‘lturg‘uchi bu yigit Toshkandning mashhur a’yonlaridan bo‘lg‘an Yusufbek hojining o‘g‘li — Otabek.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Saroy darbozasidan ikki kishi kelib kirgach, ulardan biravi darboza yonidag‘i kimdandir so‘radi: — Otabek shu saroyga tushkanmi?
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Bizga tanish hujra ko‘rsatilishi bilan ular shu tomonga qarab yurdilar.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Ular hujraga kelib kirdilar. Otabek kelguchilarni ulug‘lab qarshiladi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Soqolining oqlig‘iga qaramasdan uning qaddida keksalik alomatlari sezilmas va tusida ham uncha o‘zgarish yo‘q edi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Otabek mehmonlarni tanchaga o‘tquzib, fotihadan so‘ng Hasanalidan so‘radi: — Tuzukmisiz, ota
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Hasanali chiqdi. Rahmat Otabek bilan yana bir qaytib sog‘liq so‘rashqandan keyin so‘radi: — Bu kishi kimingiz bo‘ladir, bek aka?
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Hasanali dasturxon yozib qumg‘on kirgizdi. Odatiy takalluflar bilan dasturxon va choyga qaraldi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Rahmat kulib Otabekka qaradi. Otabek ham istehzolik tabassum orasi Homidga ko‘z qirini tashladi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Homid mag‘rur bir tusda Otabekka qaradi. Otabek uning so‘zidan kulimsiragan edi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Hasanali palovg‘a urnash uchun tashqariga chiqdi. Otabek mehmonlarga choy quyib uzatdi.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_latin.text: Oshdan so‘ng mehmonlar bilan xayrlashib chiqdilar.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Oz-oz o‘rganib dono bo‘lur, qatra-qatra yig‘ilib daryo bo‘lur.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Odam ersang, demagil odami, oniki, yo‘q xalq g‘amidin g‘ami.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Sabr bila bog‘liq ish ochilur, ishda oshiqqan ko‘p toyilur.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Qil yaxshilig‘u, demakni doxil qilma, minnat bila yaxshiliqni botil qilma.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Ma’dani inson gavhari so‘z durur, gulshani odam samari so‘z durur.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Tilga ehtiyotsiz — elga e’tiborsiz.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Tiling birla ko‘nglingni bir tut.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Tilingni o‘z ixtiyoringda asra.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Yaxshilik qila olmasang, bori yomonliq ham qilma.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Yigitlikda yig‘ ilmning maxzani, qarilik chog‘i xarj qil ani.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: Sihat tilasang, ko‘p yema, izzat tilasang, ko‘p dema.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_latin.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_latin.text: So‘zni ko‘ngulda pishqarmaguncha tilga keltirma, va harneki ko‘ngulda bor — tilga surma.
uzbek_latin.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: 1264-инчи ҳижрий, далв ойининг ўн еттинчиси, қишки кунларнинг бири, қуёш ботқан, теваракдан шом азони эшитиладир...
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Сарой аҳли кундузги иш кучларидан бўшаб ҳужраларига қайтқанлар, кўб ҳужралар кечлик ош пишириш ила машғул, шунинг учун кундузгига қарағанда сарой жонлиқ: кишиларнинг шақиллашиб сўзлашишлари, хохолаб кулишишлари саройни кўкка кўтаргудек.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Оғир табиъатлик, улуғ ғавдалик, кўркам ва оқ юзлик, келишган, қора кўзлик, мутаносиб қора қошлиқ ва эндигина мурти сабз урган бир йигит.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Бас, бу ҳужра бино ва жиҳоз ёғидан, ҳам эга жиҳатидан диққатни ўзига жалб этарлик эди.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Қандоғдир бир хаёл ичида ўлтурғучи бу йигит Тошканднинг машҳур аъёнларидан бўлған Юсуфбек ҳожининг ўғли — Отабек.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Сарой дарбозасидан икки киши келиб киргач, улардан бирави дарбоза ёнидағи кимдандир сўради: — Отабек шу саройга тушканми?
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Бизга таниш ҳужра кўрсатилиши билан улар шу томонга қараб юрдилар.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Улар ҳужрага келиб кирдилар. Отабек келгучиларни улуғлаб қаршилади.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Соқолининг оқлиғига қарамасдан унинг қаддида кексалик аломатлари сезилмас ва тусида ҳам унча ўзгариш йўқ эди.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Отабек меҳмонларни танчага ўтқузиб, фотиҳадан сўнг Ҳасаналидан сўради: — Тузукмисиз, ота
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Ҳасанали чиқди. Раҳмат Отабек билан яна бир қайтиб соғлиқ сўрашқандан кейин сўради: — Бу киши кимингиз бўладир, бек ака?
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Ҳасанали дастурхон ёзиб қумғон киргизди. Одатий такаллуфлар билан дастурхон ва чойга қаралди.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Раҳмат кулиб Отабекка қаради. Отабек ҳам истеҳзолик табассум ораси Ҳомидга кўз қирини ташлади.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Ҳомид мағрур бир тусда Отабекка қаради. Отабек унинг сўзидан кулимсираган эди.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Ҳасанали паловға урнаш учун ташқарига чиқди. Отабек меҳмонларга чой қуйиб узатди.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Abdulla Qodiriy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Ошдан сўнг меҳмонлар билан хайрлашиб чиқдилар.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Оз-оз ўрганиб доно бўлур, қатра-қатра йиғилиб дарё бўлур.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Одам эрсанг, демагил одами, оники, йўқ халқ ғамидин ғами.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Сабр била боғлиқ иш очилур, ишда ошиққан кўп тойилур.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Қил яхшилиғу, демакни дохил қилма, миннат била яхшилиқни ботил қилма.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Маъдани инсон гавҳари сўз дурур, гулшани одам самари сўз дурур.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Тилга эҳтиёциз — элга эътиборсиз.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Тилинг бирла кўнглингни бир тут.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Тилингни ўз ихтиёрингда асра.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Яхшилик қила олмасанг, бори ёмонлиқ ҳам қилма.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Йигитликда йиғ илмнинг махзани, қарилик чоғи харж қил ани.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Сиҳат тиласанг, кўп ема, иззат тиласанг, кўп дема.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

uzbek_cyrillic.author: Alisher Navoiy
uzbek_cyrillic.text: Сўзни кўнгулда пишқармагунча тилга келтирма, ва ҳарнеки кўнгулда бор — тилга сурма.
uzbek_cyrillic.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing. Transliteration from Uzbek Latin; not a separate published edition.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Все счастливые семьи похожи друг на друга, каждая несчастливая семья несчастлива по-своему.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Все смешалось в доме Облонских.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Положение это продолжалось уже третий день и мучительно чувствовалось и самими супругами, и всеми членами семьи, и домочадцами.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Жена не выходила из своих комнат, мужа третий день не было дома.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Он повернул свое полное, выхоленное тело на пружинах дивана, как бы желая опять заснуть надолго, с другой стороны крепко обнял подушку и прижался к ней щекой; но вдруг вскочил, сел на диван и открыл глаза.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Глаза Степана Аркадьича весело заблестели, и он задумался, улыбаясь.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: Да, хорошо было, очень хорошо. Много еще что-то там было отличного, да не скажешь словами и мыслями даже наяву не выразишь.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Лев Толстой
russian.text: И тут он вспомнил вдруг, как и почему он спит не в спальне жены, а в кабинете; улыбка исчезла с его лица, он сморщил лоб.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Отец мой Андрей Петрович Гринев в молодости своей служил при графе Минихе и вышел в отставку премьер-майором в 17.. году.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Нас было девять человек детей. Все мои братья и сестры умерли во младенчестве.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Я считался в отпуску до окончания наук. В то время воспитывались мы не по-нонешнему.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: С пятилетнего возраста отдан я был на руки стремянному Савельичу, за трезвое поведение пожалованному мне в дядьки.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Приезд его сильно не понравился Савельичу.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Мы тотчас поладили, и хотя по контракту обязан он был учить меня по-французски, по-немецки и всем наукам, но он предпочел наскоро выучиться от меня кое-как болтать по-русски, — и потом каждый из нас занимался уже своим делом.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Мы жили душа в душу.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Александр Пушкин
russian.text: Другого ментора я и не желал. Но вскоре судьба нас разлучила, и вот по какому случаю:
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Молодая рыжая собака — помесь такса с дворняжкой — очень похожая мордой на лисицу, бегала взад и вперёд по тротуару и беспокойно оглядывалась по сторонам.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Изредка она останавливалась и, плача, приподнимая то одну озябшую лапу, то другую, старалась дать себе отчёт: как это могло случиться, что она заблудилась?
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Она отлично помнила, как она провела день и как в конце концов попала на этот незнакомый тротуар.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Услыхав своё имя, помесь таксы с дворняжкой вышла из-под верстака, где она спала на стружках, сладко потянулась и побежала за хозяином.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Каштанка помнила, что по дороге она вела себя крайне неприлично.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: От радости, что её взяли гулять, она прыгала, бросалась с лаем на вагоны конно-железки, забегала во дворы и гонялась за собаками.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Когда она опомнилась, музыка уже не играла и полка не было.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Антон Чехов
russian.text: Она перебежала дорогу к тому месту, где оставила хозяина, но, увы! столяра уже там не было.
russian.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Понемногу учась, становишься мудрым; капля за каплей собирается река.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Не называй человеком того, кто не заботится о бедах народа.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Терпение распутывает сложное дело; торопливый часто спотыкается.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Делай добро без хвастовства; не уничтожай доброту упрёками.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Слово — драгоценность человеческой души, плод сада человечности.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Неосторожность в речи — неуважение к людям.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Пусть твой язык и твоё сердце будут едины.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Держи свой язык под собственным контролем.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Если не можешь делать добро, хотя бы не делай зла.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: В молодости собирай сокровища знаний, в старости пользуйся ими.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Желаешь здоровья — не ешь слишком много; желаешь уважения — не говори слишком много.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

russian.author: Alisher Navoiy
russian.text: Не произноси слова, пока мысль не созрела в сердце; не говори всего, что в нём есть.
russian.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.text: You want to tell me, and I have no objection to hearing it.

english.text: This was invitation enough.

english.text: Mr. Bennet made no answer.

english.text: She told the story, however, with great spirit among her friends; for she had a lively, playful disposition, which delighted in anything ridiculous.

english.text: With a book, he was regardless of time; and on the present occasion he had a good deal of curiosity as to the event of an evening which had raised such splendid expectations.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: It was the best of times, it was the worst of times, it was the age of wisdom, it was the age of foolishness.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: It was the year of Our Lord one thousand seven hundred and seventy-five.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: There was a steaming mist in all the hollows, and it had roamed in its forlornness up the hill, like an evil spirit, seeking rest and finding none.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: Whenever the leader made this rattle, the passenger started, as a nervous passenger might, and was disturbed in mind.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: Two other passengers, besides the one, were plodding up the hill by the side of the mail. All three were wrapped to the cheekbones and over the ears, and wore jack-boots.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: The last burst carried the mail to the summit of the hill. The horses stopped to breathe again, and the guard got down to skid the wheel for the descent, and open the coach-door to let the passengers in.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: They all looked from the coachman to the guard, and from the guard to the coachman, and listened.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: The sound of a horse at a gallop came fast and furiously up the hill.

english.author: Charles Dickens
english.text: A wonderful fact to reflect upon, that every human creature is constituted to be that profound secret and mystery to every other.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: In another moment down went Alice after it, never once considering how in the world she was to get out again.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: The rabbit-hole went straight on like a tunnel for some way, and then dipped suddenly down, so suddenly that Alice had not a moment to think about stopping herself before she found herself falling down a very deep well.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: Either the well was very deep, or she fell very slowly, for she had plenty of time as she went down to look about her and to wonder what was going to happen next.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: First, she tried to look down and make out what she was coming to, but it was too dark to see anything.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: Down, down, down. Would the fall never come to an end?
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: Alice was not a bit hurt, and she jumped up on to her feet in a moment.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Lewis Carroll
english.text: There was not a moment to be lost: away went Alice like the wind.
english.note: Public-domain original; whitespace and apostrophe typography normalized for typing.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: By learning little by little, one becomes wise; drop by drop, a river gathers.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Do not call someone human if they have no concern for the troubles of the people.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Patience unties a tangled task; those who hurry often stumble.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Do good without boasting of it; do not undo kindness with reproach.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: The word is the jewel of the human mine, the fruit of the garden of humanity.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Carelessness with language is disrespect toward people.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Keep your tongue and your heart in agreement.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Keep your tongue under your own control.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: If you cannot do good, at least do no harm.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Gather the treasure of knowledge in youth; spend it in old age.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: If you seek health, do not eat too much; if you seek respect, do not speak too much.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.

english.author: Alisher Navoiy
english.text: Do not speak before a thought has ripened in your heart; do not voice everything that is within it.
english.note: Qalamtype original practice translation from the public-domain Uzbek line; not a quotation from a published translated edition.
